text.aria-label: Title text 'Bad readings injected into the six Primaries' own readings, lead 24 to 72 hours. Share = summed absolute shift of the median over the summed absolute change of the three lag values. MAD: the stage-1 residual median absolute deviation.'
text.tspan: Bad readings injected into the six Primaries' own readings, lead 24 to 72 hours.
Share = summed absolute shift of the median over the summed absolute change of
the three lag values. MAD: the stage-1 residual median absolute deviation.
